rows.name: 1 · Bass + chords
rows.idea: The right hand plays the chord on every beat over an octave held in the left.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: Chord on every beat

rows.name: 2 · Broken chords
rows.idea: Over a held octave, the right hand rocks between the chord’s upper notes and its lowest note.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: Broken chord: upper notes, lowest

rows.name: 3 · Arpeggio (3rd, then 5th + octave)
rows.idea: The left hand plays 1–5–8 up the chord, then the right hand adds the 3rd and holds the 5th and octave.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8 (no 3rd) · RH: Arpeggio: 3rd, then 5th + octave

rows.name: 4 · Arpeggio 1–5–8 · 3–5–8–5–3
rows.idea: One arpeggio in 8ths climbs from the left hand into the right and comes back down.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8 (no 3rd) · RH: Arpeggio 3–5–8–5–3

rows.name: 5 · Bass + chords (dotted bass)
rows.idea: The right hand plays the chord on every beat over left-hand octaves in a long, short rhythm.
rows.hands: LH: Dotted octaves ♩. ♪ · RH: Chord on every beat

rows.name: ♪♩ Chord, then octave jumps
rows.idea: The chord, then its root alone, jumping up one octave and then two.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: ♪♩ Chord, then octave jumps

rows.name: ♪♪♪♪ Arpeggio up two octaves
rows.idea: Over a held bass, the right hand runs up the chord for two octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: ♪♪♪♪ Arpeggio up two octaves

rows.name: ♬ Runs down to the root
rows.idea: The 2nd and 5th together, then a run down 3, 2, 1 to the root; twice, an octave apart.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: ♬ 2nd and 5th, then down 3–2–1

rows.name: ♫ Run up 1–2–3–5
rows.idea: The root, 2nd, 3rd and 5th in 8ths, climbing two octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: ♫ Up 1–2–3–5 over two octaves

rows.name: ♩.♪♩ Dotted chords
rows.idea: A dotted chord, then the same chord an octave higher and held, over a wide arpeggio.
rows.hands: LH: Wide arpeggio 1–5–8–10–12–10 · RH: ♩.♪♩ Dotted chord, then an octave up

rows.name: 3 chords
rows.idea: The same chord in three octaves, climbing, over a wide arpeggio.
rows.hands: LH: Wide arpeggio 1–5–8–10–12–10 · RH: 3 chords an octave apart

rows.name: Inversions: root, 1st, 2nd
rows.idea: The chord in root position, then its 1st and 2nd inversions, over an arpeggio up to the 12th.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8–10, the 12th held · RH: Inversions: root, 1st, 2nd

rows.name: 5.1 · The ♭7 under the root
rows.idea: The chord twice, then twice with its ♭7 added under the root, over dotted octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Dotted octaves ♩. ♪ · RH: 5.1 The ♭7 under the root

rows.name: 5.2 · Falling line 1–7–♭7–6
rows.idea: The lowest note of the chord falls by semitones: 1, 7, ♭7, 6.
rows.hands: LH: Dotted octaves ♩. ♪ · RH: 5.2 Falling line 1–7–♭7–6

rows.name: 5.3 · The 3rd moves 3–2–4–3
rows.idea: The 3rd steps to the 2nd, up to the 4th and back, over dotted octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Dotted octaves ♩. ♪ · RH: 5.3 The 3rd moves 3–2–4–3

rows.name: Rising sixths
rows.idea: Pairs of notes a 6th apart climb from the 3rd to the 5th over a 1–5–8–5 bass.
rows.hands: LH: 1–5–8–5 in quarters · RH: 6th↑ Rising sixths

rows.name: Falling sixths
rows.idea: Pairs of notes a 6th apart fall from the 5th to the 3rd over a 1–5–8–5 bass.
rows.hands: LH: 1–5–8–5 in quarters · RH: 6th↓ Falling sixths

rows.name: Octaves
rows.idea: Over a held octave bass, the right hand plays 1–2–3–5 in octaves, twice, climbing.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: Octaves 1–2–3–5, two octaves up

rows.name: Octaves (scale)
rows.idea: Over a held octave bass, the right hand climbs the scale in octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Octave, whole note · RH: Octaves up the scale

rows.name: Chords
rows.idea: Four-note chords on every beat, the outer notes stepping up and back, over a climbing arpeggio.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8–10, the 12th held · RH: Chord with its octave, the outer notes up a step and back

rows.name: 1 · Harmonic basis
rows.idea: Chords and bass together in long, even notes, like a chorale.
rows.hands: LH: Octave on beats 1 and 3 · RH: Held chords (half notes)

rows.name: 2 · Bass–chord alternation
rows.idea: The bass on the strong beats, the chord on the beats between.
rows.hands: LH: Bass on beats 1 and 3 (root, 5th) · RH: Chord on the off-beats

rows.name: 3 · Chord pulse
rows.idea: The chord repeats in 8ths over a bass on beats 1 and 3.
rows.hands: LH: Bass on beats 1 and 3 (root, 5th) · RH: Pulsing chords (8ths)

rows.name: 4 · Harmonic figuration
rows.idea: A flowing arpeggio passed from the left hand to the right, which plays chord notes 1–3–2–4–3 from the bottom.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8 (no 3rd) · RH: Figuration 1–3–2–4–3

rows.name: 4b · Broken arpeggios
rows.idea: Over a moving bass, the right hand breaks the chord: its lowest, top, middle and top notes.
rows.hands: LH: Bass on beats 1 and 3 (root, 5th) · RH: Broken arpeggio 1–3–2–3

rows.name: 5 · Melody doubling
rows.idea: The right hand plays the tune; the left hand breaks the chord under it.
rows.hands: LH: Broken chord 1–5–10–5 · RH: Melody (doubling the tune)

rows.name: 6 · Elements of the melody
rows.idea: The tune at the start and end of each phrase, with figuration between.
rows.hands: LH: Arpeggio 1–5–8 (no 3rd) · RH: Melody at phrase starts and ends

rows.name: 7 · Harmony in the melody
rows.idea: The tune on top, with chord notes added under its long notes.
rows.hands: LH: 1–5–8–5 in quarters · RH: Melody with chord notes under it

rows.name: 1 · Chord pulse
rows.idea: The chord on every beat over the held root, with beats 1 and 4 brighter.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Chord pulse, beats 1 and 4 brighter

rows.name: 2 · Pulse with the 2nd
rows.idea: Each chord gets its 2nd, D in C major, and pulses on every beat over the root.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Pulse with the 2nd added

rows.name: 3 · Broken in 8ths
rows.idea: In 8ths: the 3rd and 5th together, then the 2nd under them. A new texture for a new section.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Broken in 8ths: 3rd and 5th, then the 2nd

rows.name: 4 · Harmonic figuration
rows.idea: Sixteenths through the chord: its 5th, then up 1, 2 and 3.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Figuration in 16ths: 5, then 1–2–3

rows.name: 5 · Pulse, then a run
rows.idea: The chord on beats 1 to 3, then a run down 5, 3, 2, 1 on beat 4.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Pulse on 1–3, a run down on 4

rows.name: 6 · A line on beats 3 and 4
rows.idea: The chord for two beats, then a line down its 9th, 7th, 5th and 3rd.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: A line down 9–7–5–3 on beats 3 and 4

rows.name: Whole notes
rows.idea: The whole chord held for the bar over its root.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Whole-note chord

rows.name: Chord flow (I–IV–I–V–I shapes)
rows.idea: Over a held root, the right hand moves through the key’s I, IV, I, V and back to I.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Chord flow: I–IV–I–V–I shapes

rows.name: Pop 8ths
rows.idea: Steady chords in 8ths over a root on beats 1 and 3.
rows.hands: LH: Root on beats 1 and 3 · RH: Pulsing chords (8ths)

rows.name: Pop syncopated
rows.idea: Chords that land just ahead of the beat over a syncopated root.
rows.hands: LH: Syncopated root · RH: Syncopated chords

rows.name: Ballad arpeggio
rows.idea: A gentle arpeggio over the root and 5th.
rows.hands: LH: Root, then 5th · RH: Ballad arpeggio

rows.name: Rock
rows.idea: Driving chords in 8ths over octaves in 8ths.
rows.hands: LH: Driving octaves (8ths) · RH: Rock 8ths

rows.name: Blues shuffle
rows.idea: Short shuffled chords over a 1–5–6–5 boogie bass.
rows.hands: LH: Shuffle 1–5–6–5 · RH: Blues shuffle stabs

rows.name: R&B
rows.idea: Relaxed chords over a syncopated R&B bass.
rows.hands: LH: R&B bass · RH: R&B chords

rows.name: Jazz Charleston
rows.idea: The Charleston rhythm, on beat 1 and just before beat 3, over the root and 5th.
rows.hands: LH: Root, then 5th · RH: Charleston

rows.name: Hip-hop
rows.idea: A few syncopated chords over a held root.
rows.hands: LH: Root, whole note · RH: Hip-hop chords

rows.name: Salsa montuno
rows.idea: The montuno, a broken chord that pushes across the beat, over a tumbao bass.
rows.hands: LH: Salsa tumbao · RH: Salsa montuno

rows.name: Funk
rows.idea: Short, sharp chords over a busy funk bass.
rows.hands: LH: Funk bass · RH: Funk stabs

rows.name: Gospel
rows.idea: Syncopated chords over gospel octaves.
rows.hands: LH: Gospel octaves · RH: Syncopated chords

rows.name: Country
rows.idea: Chords on the off-beats over a bass that alternates the root and 5th.
rows.hands: LH: Root, then 5th · RH: Country off-beats
